subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: When was the state of Kerala formed?
explanation: Kerala was formed on 1 November 1956 under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 (Kerala Piravi day).

subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: How many districts does Kerala have?
explanation: Kerala has 14 districts; Kasaragod (1984) was the most recent to be formed.

subject: Kerala Geography
textMl: കേരളത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും നീളം കൂടിയ നദി ഏതാണ്?
textEn: Which is the longest river in Kerala?
explanation: The Periyar, about 244 km long, is the longest river in Kerala.

subject: Kerala Geography
textMl: കേരളത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും ഉയരം കൂടിയ കൊടുമുടി ഏതാണ്?
textEn: Which is the highest peak in Kerala?
explanation: Anamudi in Idukki district (about 2,695 m) is the highest peak in Kerala and in South India.

subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: What is the capital of Kerala?
explanation: Thiruvananthapuram is the capital of Kerala.

subject: Kerala Geography
textMl: വിസ്തീർണ്ണത്തിൽ കേരളത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും ചെറിയ ജില്ല ഏതാണ്?
textEn: Which is the smallest district of Kerala by area?
explanation: Alappuzha is the smallest district of Kerala by area.

subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: How many rivers are there in Kerala?
explanation: Kerala has 44 rivers: 41 flow west and 3 flow east.

subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: How many rivers in Kerala flow east?
explanation: Three rivers flow east: Kabani, Bhavani and Pambar.

subject: Indian Constitution
textEn: When did the Constitution of India come into force?
explanation: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950 (Republic Day).

subject: Indian Constitution
textEn: Who was the chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
explanation: Dr B. R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee; Rajendra Prasad was President of the Constituent Assembly.

subject: Indian Constitution
textEn: Which Article of the Constitution abolishes untouchability?
explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

subject: Indian Constitution
textMl: ഇന്ത്യൻ രാഷ്ട്രപതിയാകാൻ വേണ്ട കുറഞ്ഞ പ്രായം എത്ര?
textEn: What is the minimum age to be elected President of India?
explanation: Article 58 requires a candidate for President to have completed 35 years of age.

subject: Indian Constitution
textEn: Which constitutional amendment added the Fundamental Duties?
explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) added the Fundamental Duties in Part IV-A (Article 51A).

subject: General Science
textEn: What is the chemical symbol of gold?
explanation: Au, from the Latin aurum. Ag is silver and Gd is gadolinium.

subject: General Science
textMl: സൂര്യപ്രകാശം ഏൽക്കുമ്പോൾ ത്വക്കിൽ ഉൽപ്പാദിപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന വിറ്റാമിൻ ഏതാണ്?
textEn: Which vitamin is produced in the skin when it is exposed to sunlight?
explanation: Ultraviolet light lets the skin make vitamin D.

subject: General Science
textEn: What is the SI unit of force?
explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N). The joule is energy, the watt power and the pascal pressure.

subject: General Science
textEn: Which is the largest planet in the Solar System?
explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.

subject: General Science
textEn: What is the hardest naturally occurring substance?
explanation: Diamond, a form of carbon, is the hardest natural substance (10 on the Mohs scale).

subject: General Science
textEn: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere?
explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of dry air; oxygen is about 21%.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: In which year was the SNDP Yogam founded?
explanation: The Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana Yogam was founded in 1903 with Sree Narayana Guru as its president.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: In which year did the Vaikom Satyagraha begin?
explanation: The Vaikom Satyagraha began in 1924 and continued into 1925.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: In which year was the Temple Entry Proclamation issued in Travancore?
explanation: Maharaja Chithira Thirunal issued the Temple Entry Proclamation on 12 November 1936.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: Who founded the Sadhu Jana Paripalana Sangham?
explanation: Ayyankali founded the Sadhu Jana Paripalana Sangham in 1907.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: Who founded the Nair Service Society?
explanation: Mannathu Padmanabhan founded the Nair Service Society (NSS) in 1914.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: In which year did the Guruvayur Satyagraha begin?
explanation: The Guruvayur Satyagraha began in 1931, led by K. Kelappan.

subject: Indian History
textEn: In which year did the First War of Indian Independence take place?
explanation: The Revolt of 1857 is called the First War of Indian Independence.

subject: Indian History
textEn: In which year did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre take place?
explanation: The massacre took place in Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

subject: Indian History
textEn: In which year did the Dandi March take place?
explanation: Gandhi's Salt March to Dandi ran from 12 March to 6 April 1930.

subject: Indian History
textMl: ഇന്ത്യൻ നാഷണൽ കോൺഗ്രസ് സ്ഥാപിതമായ വർഷം ഏതാണ്?
textEn: In which year was the Indian National Congress founded?
explanation: The Indian National Congress was founded in Bombay in December 1885.

subject: Indian History
textEn: Who was the first Governor-General of independent India?
explanation: Lord Mountbatten was the first Governor-General of independent India; C. Rajagopalachari was the first (and last) Indian Governor-General.
